title: Promise and Vow
author: Dominic Thornbury
blurb: Lior Dunmore, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. But when a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
